name: Security Misconfiguration Review
description: Authorized scope: approved, reviewed signature templates (read-only GET/HEAD fingerprints) and built-in checks, then analyst review.
legal_notes: Only for assets you own or hold written authorization to test. This workflow never sends a request itself: it reads authorization and observation records, and a person creates, approves and starts every exact plan in the Verification workspace. Findings are observations to verify, not proof of compromise.
quota_note: No network requests (works on local data)
example_output: Evidence-linked low-impact findings for analyst review, with no exploitation claims.
capability_gaps: This workflow is manual only and cannot send requests: checks run from the Verification workspace after a person approves the exact plan.
Not verified against third-party sites: every check was exercised against local lab servers only.
Nuclei is optional. Only templates you approved by id and content hash are ever run; the bundled community template library is not used.
instructions: Authorized scope: approved, reviewed signature templates (read-only GET/HEAD fingerprints) and built-in checks, then analyst review.

definition.name: Security Misconfiguration Review
definition.description: Authorized scope: approved, reviewed signature templates (read-only GET/HEAD fingerprints) and built-in checks, then analyst review.

config.prompt: Confirm you own the asset or hold written authorization to test it, and that the authorization names the host, ports and checks. Consent from a person is not authorization for their domains.

Open Verification > Templates and confirm the signature templates you intend to use are reviewed and approved by id and hash. Create a plan with a signature check, approve the exact plan and start it.
Treat every match as a lead. Confirm it by hand, mark false positives, and record low-impact remediation. No exploitation is attempted or implied.
